Overview

Medellín is a city in AN with a population of 2,500,000. The City of Eternal Spring, transformed from a troubled past into a model of urban innovation with its metro cable system and green spaces. Housing is notably more expensive than the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 32.0.
